successors.name: Deheubarth
successors.text: Dyfed incorporated by Hywel Dda 'Through his marriage to Elen' into the enlarged realm of Deheubarth

ledger.x: c. 410: Dyfed emerges in sub-Roman Britain. 'one of several petty kingdoms that emerged in 5th-century sub-Roman Britain in southwest Wales'; infobox 'Established: c. 410'; 'The royal line was founded by Irish settlers in the 5th century'.
Late 7th century: Dyfed loses Ystrad Tywi.

wars.name: Viking raids on Dyfed
wars.outcome: 'Dyfed was subject to extensive raids during the Viking Age between the 8th and 11th centuries'; in 999 a Viking raiding party attacked St Davids and killed Bishop Morganau.

certainty.note: The page gives rivers, cantrefi and an area, no boundary.
